item.title: Unable to connect NSX to Lookup Service when using a vSphere 6 subordinate certificate authority (VMCA)
item.description: After deploying a new vSphere 6 vCenter Server Appliance (VCSA) and configuring the Platform Services Controller (PSC) to act as a subordinate Certificate Authority (CS), I was unable to register the NSX Manager to the Lookup Service. Try saying that fast after a pint or two!?
